label: adjudicate
tail:
Done. All seven rejections adjudicated, all repaired, all gates green.

## Verdict: seven rejections, all real, none fatal, all fixed

Every complaint checked out against the item text **and** the exact published statement of the cited dependency — I opened each candidate before citing it. **No false positives.** Every gap was closable from already-published material, so nothing was invented, weakened, or deferred.

| item | lane(s) | what was actually missing | repaired with |
|---|---|---|---|
| `thm-taylor-series-representation-by-remainder` | both | nothing said $[a-r,a+r]$ was compact; nothing licensed continuity of $\lvert f^{(n+1)}\rvert$ | `thm-heine-borel-r`, `thm-algebra-of-continuous-functions` cl. 2, `def-higher-derivatives-and-smoothness` |
| `thm-standard-maclaurin-expansions` | terra | $\binom nk$ is **defined as a count** here, explicitly not as a quotient — the recurrence had no bridge | `thm-binomial-closed-formula`, plus the induction written out |
| ″ | deepseek | `[L6]` is the power derivative on $(0,\infty)$ only; the affine substitution had no chain rule | `thm-chain-rule` + `lem-derivative-of-a-power`, both limit-point hypotheses discharged |
| `thm-euler-mascheroni-…` | terra | integral monotonicity can't compare different upper limits | additivity + nonnegativity, case-split at $n=2^m$ so no oriented-integral convention is needed |
| `def-radian-angle-…` | deepseek | **real degenerate defect**: a circular arc requires $\alpha<\beta$, so $t=0$ was outside the cited definition | $t=0$ now handled explicitly as the one-point path, *said not to be an arc*, length 0 from the path-length singleton convention |
| `cex-smooth-function-…` | deepseek | $q'(x)=2x$ had no home — the induction had no base | `lem-derivative-of-a-power` |

The $t=0$ case I fixed honestly rather than papering over, per your instruction: the arc language now runs for $0<t\le2\pi$ and the degenerate case is stated as what it is. **No approved statement changed** — all five plan controls hold, including the $\lvert x\rvert<1$ binomial restriction, the explicit $M_{n+1}$, and acute-angle-only.

## Two things worth your attention

**`rendercheck` was failing on this batch before I arrived — 9 errors, 4 files.** Displays written across several source lines mis-render on the live page. The judges don't look at this, so on the judge verdicts alone four of the seven new pages would have published rendering wrong. All nine sat in items I was already repairing, so joining each display onto one line cost no extra rejudge and touched no untouched sibling. **Rendercheck now passes on all seven.**

**Two items untouched and not for rejudge:** `def-taylor-and-maclaurin-series` and `thm-analytic-sine-cosine-agree-with-right-triangle-ratios` — both passed both lanes with no finding, and I verified their judge-normalized hashes are still byte-identical to the text the judges read. I re-checked the latter's `[F9]`, which restates the radian definition I repaired: still faithful, and it uses it only at $\theta\in(0,\pi/2)$, inside the arc case.

## Artifacts

- `research/ra-enrich-01-adjudications.jsonl` — 7 rows, all `confirmed_nonfatal`, hashes validated row-by-row against the judge ledger
- `research/ra-enrich-01-rejudge-targets.json` — the 5 changed ids
- `research/ra-enrich-01-alpha-report.md` — per-rejection evidence, gate results, hash receipts

Gates: precheck 4/4 clean · citecheck, prosecheck, rendercheck, depcheck, fwdcheck, extcheck all OK. No forward reference introduced — I verified every new dependency's page order sits strictly below its consumer's target page rather than assuming it. No `verification.judge` or `audited` written, nothing published.

One note: `research/plan-category-theory-track.md` and `plan-functional-analysis-track.md` show as modified in the working tree. Those aren't mine — I never wrote to either.
